dedupe_keys.name: a multi feature dataset of daily electricity demand with meteorological holiday and special event attributes for mirpur and gulshan zones of dhaka bangladesh 2024 2025

description: A Multi-Feature Dataset of Daily Electricity Demand with Meteorological, Holiday, and Special Event Attributes for Mirpur and Gulshan Zones of Dhaka, Bangladesh (2024–2025) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors MD Sajid Hasan Sajid, Sanjida Khanom (Bangladesh University of Business and Technology). This dataset contains 597 daily electricity demand records covering the continuous period from 1 January 2024 to 19 August 2025 for two representative Electricity Distribution Service Areas (EDSAs) in Dhaka, Bangladesh: Mirpur (23.8223°N, 90.3654°E), a predominantly residential area, and Gulshan (23.7925°N, 90.4078°E), a predominantly commercial area. Coverage: national (BD); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
